# TASKS_TEMPLATE.md

State: draft

This is the official TASKS template for feature execution. Copy this file to `docs/features/<feature>/TASKS.md` when starting a new feature.

## 1. Checklist

Tag each task with its agent: `[implementer]` writes/tests, `[explorer]` reads/investigates, `[orchestrator]` decides/reviews.

- [ ] Task 1 `[implementer]`: ...
- [ ] Task 2 `[explorer]`: ...
- [ ] Task 3 `[orchestrator]`: review against SPEC acceptance criteria

## 2. Test/ Security Gates

- [ ] Unit tests passing
- [ ] Integration tests passing
- [ ] Architecture boundary check
- [ ] Security boundary check
- [ ] Type/lint check passing

## 3. Progress Log

| Date | Action | Status |
|------|--------|--------|
| ... | ... | ... |

## 4. Key Learnings (to move to ADRs or external memory)

- ...
